notes.note: Xerri was the best scorer for the Roos with 32 hit outs a goal and 22 disposals this week and of course his signature 7 tackles. He looks to be back to full health and rucked well against Cameron.
Xerri was still starting at centre half forward and not taking the centre bounces. Just 12 disposals and 14 hit outs as he isn't providing the scoring we are used to from him.

Xerri has suffered a fractured jaw and will now be missing for the next couple of weeks at least. So most will need to hold with limited trades left but he is not one to bring in if you were considering him.
Xerri had a goal and 14 disposals but as usual it is the 7 tackles that helped his score the most. His BE has dropped to 68 with the 43 out of his cycle now.

Xerri has been very hot and cold of late but he took full advantage of the Eagles inexperienced Ruck department with 8 tackles and 6 clearances to go with his 16 disposals. His BE is still at 141 so maybe wait another week.

Xerri had a high BE and was one to keep an eye o and with this week him having just 2 kicks 10 handballs and 15 hit outs against a dominant Luke Jackson that BE has risen to 188. Wait for him for a bit longer now.
Xerri kicked a goal and had 8 tackles which are the trademark of his game. Fourth over 100 in the last five games for him.
Xerri battled with McAndrew but ultimately had his second worse score this year. His tackle count was well down at just 2 as North were well beaten all over the ground.
Xerri won the battle with Grundy despite losing the hit out count. He was more dominant around the ground with 9 clearances and 19 disposals.
Xerri was massive as he topped last week's big score. 26 contested disposals and 14 clearances to go with 30 disposals. He was unstoppable against the undermanned Cats rucks.
Xerri came back in and made up for lost time as he led the game in tackles contested possessions and clearances. He is one that we need to target.

Xerri was a popular trade in but had a horrible score with 3 free kicks against and 15 disposals. However he will be suspended after wiping blood on McGrath. He is now missing for 3 weeks so you could trade him.

Xerri went to another level against Flynn and was just short of the 200 mark with 43 hitouts and 23 contested possessions amongst his 25 disposals and 9 tackles. Any thoughts he was going to struggle with the new rules are being put to bed.
Xerri dominated around the ground against the younger Power ruckman but he didn't have a hit out in the first quarter but did get  his 10 tackles to lead the game in that category.
